title: test(imap): update e2e smoke tests for IMAP4REV2 and NAMESPACE
description:
Update the end-to-end smoke tests in crates/imap/tests/e2e_smoke.rs to assert that the live server advertises IMAP4rev2 and NAMESPACE, and that ENABLE IMAP4rev2 and NAMESPACE commands work correctly over a real TCP connection.

Changes:
1. Find the existing CAPABILITY assertion (currently lines 109–125 checking LOGINDISABLED, ENABLE, UNSELECT). Add assertions that the CAPABILITY response contains the substring IMAP4rev2 and NAMESPACE.
2. Add a new test: after TLS/auth negotiation, send 'A001 ENABLE IMAP4rev2', assert the server responds with '* ENABLED IMAP4rev2' followed by a tagged OK.
3. Add a new test: after auth, send 'A002 NAMESPACE', assert the response is '* NAMESPACE (("" ".")) NIL NIL' (or equivalent with the dot delimiter), followed by tagged OK.
4. Add a new test: send 'A003 ENABLE IMAP4rev2' a second time, assert '* ENABLED' with empty list (idempotent).

Oracle: RFC 9051 §6.3.2 (ENABLE response), RFC 2342 §5 (NAMESPACE wire format). These are protocol-level expected values, not derived from the implementation.

Note: the e2e tests spin up a real server process (or in-process listener) against localhost. Follow the existing pattern in e2e_smoke.rs for session setup.

Acceptance: cargo test -p stoa-imap --test e2e_smoke passes with all new assertions green.
